1689165126878871552.a: Nearly every person on Earth is a slave. Enslaved to their own thoughts. It's hard to realize that if you are used to thinking all the time. Silence offers a freedom unlike anything else.

1689165128745259008.a: Watching other people use CAD software made me realize how trying to use a tool to replace knowledge enslaves a person to the limitations of the tool. I say try in the "you're failing" sense. I learned drafting on a table with ink pens and stencils.

1689165130712367104.a: Having to draw on paper in ink caused me to not want to make mistakes. So I had to design the entire object in my mind first. I knew exactly-ish what I needed to draw. The whole thing finished in my head and the ink is just there to communicate it to the builders.

1689165132662706176.a: When I watch most people try to learn CAD I see them trying to design their object in the software directly with very little mind map of the work that needs to be done. They often fumble and fail a bunch then eventually figure out how to draw it; while I'm done building mine.

1689165134638256128.a: A friend taking product design (I think?) course for his Masters was frustrated that his lab partners had no idea how the real world works; never made anything. They read the books, passed the tests, and can only talk about it. Meanwhile, he has built 4 prototypes of their ideas.
